integrity: The exact proof is mathematical and self-contained; supplementary exact-rational checks are finite and do not certify infinite quantifiers.
limitations: No Euclidean-distance analogue, arbitrary convexifier extension or general-dimensional universal threshold is claimed. Earlier equivalent statements may remain unindexed.
scope: All integers n>=2, 0<=k<n, all finite real lambda>=0; standard cross-polytope, closed k-skeleton and induced l1 metric.
title: Exact cross-polytope skeleton convexification and its \(\ell_1\) Hausdorff phase transition
